tasks.description: TEMPORARY GPT-5.5 SOLO SELF-REVIEW / ZERO-SOLVER OPERATIONAL REPAIR AFTER 20260930T161553_7a0c9d9d. The previous S-TC2C wrapper failed before scientific outcome with zero solver/plant/training/validation/test resources because gate.prepare_cell called the legacy base.configure_context_no_reset path, whose global extract_goal_xy still refused the saved source242 case even though v34q had already established the authoritative source242 goal as case.tvp.trajectory_endpoint[61]. This task keeps the frozen v34z2 solver-bearing gate source unchanged at sha256 66dbf84e4a7917d824152cae1cac4da77c51efff576cd4775e8cd1be29dbcc97. It runs a wrapper-of-wrapper script that verifies that hash before importing/using the gate, updates only in-memory structured-request/TASK_ID bindings, and installs an in-memory base.extract_goal_xy patch for this preflight process only: the patch delegates to the already archived v34q robust_goal_from_saved_case evidence and fail-closes unless the source is exactly case.tvp.trajectory_endpoint[61]. The wrapper then calls the same real gate sequence as S-TC2C: load_modules(), install_nlpsol_patch(), load_context_and_terminals(), and prepare_cell(..., for_presolve_only=True) for every frozen SOLVE_ORDER arm, stopping before controller.get_action(), mpc.solve(), any low-level solver call, env.reset(), env.step(), training/refit, validation64, or sealed/final-test access. Pre-solve MPC/NLP construction remains allowed because it is the real T-C2 setup chain; optimization solve and plant rollout remain forbidden. Required outputs are the same S-TC2C pass-condition keys plus raw setup records showing source242 context construction without base.load_contexts, H15 terminal presence, per-arm intended-primal assignment/readback/hash data, the inert-intervention gate, and source242 goal provenance from the in-memory patch. If this fails with zero resources, preserve the failure and do not run solver-bearing T-C2 in the same cycle.
